# Rue Islamabad

> A candlelit cafe in F-6 Markaz, Islamabad. Specialty coffee, all-day breakfast, sandwiches and pastas. Open 8 AM to midnight, daily.

Rue is on the third floor of 1 Agha Khan Road, F-6 Markaz, Islamabad. Phone: 0337 6502222.
